a: $15,000 stipend for 9 weeks in an HHMI lab at a host institution, or $12,000 at HHMI's Janelia Research Campus (with free on-campus housing)
dt: Opens Nov 10, 2026; closes Dec 17, 2026. Program runs June 14–Aug 12, 2027
e: Rising juniors and seniors at accredited US institutions who are US citizens, permanent residents or visa holders with work authorization. Students join HHMI labs, including Janelia.
n: HHMI Cech Fellows (Summer Undergraduate Research Experience)
